inventoryHelp: Start with the previous file list and check for changes afterward. Automatic uses this when normal scanning is slow.
scopeHelp: Reuse the file list in this scope. Note contents are not cached.
noFolders: Add a folder or select Entire vault.
tabsHelp: Wait to load hidden tabs until you open them. Obsidian still chooses which note to show at startup.
pluginsHelp: Replace reads of large plugin program files with a faster method. Execution order stays the same.
previewsHelp: Show titles and icons in the tab overview to avoid generating preview images.
modeHelp: Measure normal startup turns off optimizations and records a reference startup.
recordingHelp: Keep the latest {count} runs on this device. Recording is always on when measuring normal startup.
historyHelp: Times start when in-app loading begins. UI marks screen readiness. Phase timings can overlap and cannot be added together.
indexTip: Metadata initialization; may overlap with preloading.
verificationTip: Time when background file verification finished
settingsFallbackHelp: Optimizations are off because settings could not be loaded.
settingsRecovery: Check settings storage, then restart Obsidian.
pending: Restart Obsidian to apply the changed settings.
failedHelp: Protection against writes based on an unverified file list is still active.
waitingLayout: Waiting for tabs to be restored.
indexing: Preparing the file list for verification.
finishing: Checking recent changes and pending saves.
afterUi: Changes will be checked after the UI is ready.
comparing: Checking additions, changes and deletions in {folder}.
waitHidden: Paused while the app is hidden.
waitForeground: Giving priority to opening notes or tabs.
waitInput: Giving priority to typing or scrolling.
resumeVisible: Resumes when you return to the app.
afterWatch: File verification starts once monitoring is ready.
afterRead: Changes are checked after the list is read.
background: Checking the file list in the background
inventorySaving: File list preparation: previous normal scan {normal} → this run {current} ({difference} {direction}; reference only).
comparison: Normal {normal} → optimized {optimized}: about {saved} ({percent}%) {direction}. Medians of {normalCount} normal and {optimizedCount} optimized runs; reference only{variable}.
previousScan: A previous file verification is still active. Restart Obsidian.
unsupportedApi: Obsidian {api} is not supported; using the normal scan.
emptyScope: No folders selected; using the normal scan.
missingApi: File list optimization is unavailable; using the normal scan.
ownerFailed: Could not start file verification; using the normal scan.
seedFailed: Could not load the file list. Restart Obsidian.
invalidPath: Could not verify the file path.
pendingOperation: This operation is unavailable while the file list is being checked. Try again after verification.
externalChange: The file changed outside Obsidian. Reopen it before trying again.
snapshotFailed: Could not save the file list. The next startup will use the normal scan.
